system_overview: This specification extends Dijkstra's ring-based termination detection algorithm (EWD840) with JSON trace export capabilities. When a real invariant is violated during model checking, the specification serializes the complete error trace to a JSON file, enabling integration with third-party analysis and visualization tools.
actors_and_components: The system consists of the same ring of N nodes as the base EWD840 specification. The export layer wraps the invariant check so that upon violation, the error trace is captured and written to a JSON file before TLC terminates.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from the base EWD840 specification: node activation status, node colors, token position, and token color. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: The initial state is inherited from the base EWD840 specification.
actions: All actions are inherited from the base EWD840 specification. The JSON export is triggered through the invariant mechanism rather than as a separate action.
safety_properties: The module checks the base invariant from EWD840. When the invariant is violated, instead of simply reporting the violation, the trace is serialized to JSON format and written to a file.
model_bounds: Inherits model bounds from the base EWD840 specification.
additional_assumptions: Requires the TLCExt and Json community modules (available in CommunityModules-deps.jar). The JSON serialization uses the Trace operator from TLCExt and the JsonSerialize operator from the Json module.
